cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Předmět je ukončen zkouškou, která má písemnou a ústní část. Důraz je kladen na písemnou část, jejíž úspěšné absolvování předpokládá dosažení alespoň 60 % z možných bodů. Pokud student neuspěje u písemné části, zkoušku opakuje. Na základě písemné části získávají studenti hodnocení A (alespoň 90 %), B (83 %), C (75 %), D (68 %) nebo E (60 %).

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is that the student acquires basic theoretical knowledge to create the prerequisites for understanding the mechanism of functioning of the economy, with emphasis on understanding that economic contexts are promoted as a consequence of the actions of economic entities.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction to economics (allowance 4/4) a.Why we study the economy and what is the object of economics.b.The need of economic coordination and the principles od market coordination.2.Basics of microeconomics (allowance 10/10) a.Shaping demand in markets, price elasticity of demand.b.Shaping supply in markets, concept and meanings of costs.c.Efficiency of the market and efficiency of the firm.d.Mechanism of the production factor market, formation of prices of factors.e.Labour market and unemployement.3.Basics of macroeconomics (allowance 12/12) a.Product and balance of the economy. How the economy behaves in the short and long run.b.Economic growth and business cycles.c.Money and its importance in the economy. Inflation and its consequenses.d.Government and its fiscal policy.e.Monetary policy and its goals.f.Economy as part of a transnational environment.

en.content: Student needs to pass an exam. The exam consists of written and oral part. Emphasis is placed on written part where students must obtain at least 60 % of maximum points to pass.
